_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (FY2012 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other biopharmaceutical manufacturers, including for both innovative medicines and lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'It is possible that we may lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on certain key products for most of our net sales, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

(Item 1A heading). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.46x; +31% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.34; conservative 2yr -4%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -65.2%/yr (worst year FY03-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.6%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.6%/yr (FY03-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2014-02-07) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.46x (94.0% downside to Bear $3 / +27.2% upside to Bull $64) | Adj composite 2.67 vs market 2.33: gap +0.34 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +31% above the EPP floor $38 (21x FY14E $1.82) | Conservative 2-yr case: -3.6% total (-1.8%/yr) | At 27.6x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $67 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +1.2% in Q4 2013, forward revenues +7% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2013 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
